name: print the table with nothing in it
one_line: The sheet carries the frame of a correspondence and none of its content, so nothing that printed it ever touched a letter.
how: Whenever a form needs a key — a cipher alphabet, a legend, a table of signals, a mask, a grid — print the rows and the rule and leave every value blank. Twenty-one lettered rows with a rule for the shape of the signs. A grid of numbered cells with one line saying each number is used once. A sheet of randomly half-blacked cells and a second sheet of the same cells empty. Print how many rows there are and what makes a filled row legal, and print nothing that could only have been produced by doing the work. The gain is exact: the content does not exist until a hand writes it, so it cannot be wrong, and whoever printed the sheet cannot read what comes back on it.

knobs.effect: Empty, the sheet is a machine and the secret belongs to whoever fills it. Given, the sheet is a legend to be applied, which is an easier task and one that can already be wrong before it leaves the printer.

knobs.knob: whether a legal row is defined
knobs.effect: «Each number once» or «one sign per letter» makes the filled table check itself. Without such a rule the table can be filled in a way that does not work, and the failure only appears later, in use.
Kept, it is a private notation. Given to somebody else it is a lock with two keys: neither person can read alone, and neither has to trust the other.

Twenty-one rows are an alphabet and fill a page. Nine cells are a mask. Sixty-four cells are a sheet of half-blacked squares. Past that the filling is the whole afternoon and nothing is left for the use.

where_the_work_is: In the rule that makes a filled table legal. It is the only thing printed and the only thing that can be wrong before anybody has a pen in hand, and it is usually one line long.
breaks: Empty rows print, and hand-filled rows scan if they sit eight millimetres apart or more. On 800x480 no table of twenty-one rows fits; the one-line rule and the count do. The move removes a whole class of silent failure — no key, no mask, nothing enciphered ever comes off a machine — and buys nothing at all where the difficulty is composing prose rather than filling in a correspondence.
